snippet.title: [Free Game] 'Hyakka Ryoran Master Samurai Chronicles' Official service begins!
snippet.description:
The game service G123 has officially launched Hyakka Ryoran Master Samurai Chronicles

Join the beautiful Master Samurai and carve your path through a turbulent era!

Enjoy this idle RPG featuring unique and charming sword-wielding heroines.

Start the game here:
https://s.g123.jp/59nxzop9

This title is a browser game playable on smartphones, tablets, and PC web browsers.

With fully featured idle functions perfect for spare moments, you can take your time playing on PC at home or enjoy quick sessions on your smartphone while out and about, adapting to any playstyle.

■ Game Basic Info

Game Title:  Hyakka Ryoran Master Samurai Chronicles

Genre: Idle RPG

Price: Free (with in-game Item purchases)

#HyakkaRyoran #MasterSamuraiChronicles #G123 #FreeGame #NewGame #IdleRPG
